notes: THE HIGH ANCHOR. Staged only into the verifier image and never on the agent surface. It is a BAR, not a claim to be the fastest point of this space: it is the fastest plan an authoring sweep over this harness found that also passes the equivalence gate. Its finding is that the whole span of this task is the attention backend -- the textbook one materialises the score matrix and costs about 17 percent more per step than either fused backend -- and that every other axis in the schema is a distractor that costs time rather than saving it. Chunking the cross-entropy is slower at every chunk count offered, and bfloat16 in the logit path is both slower and outside the equivalence tolerance on the gradient.
